title: plasmic-material-ui-drawer | text: Drawer
Material UI Drawer. A side panel that slides in from a screen edge. Place a detail view or an edit form alongside the current page, or show navigation. Use anchor to choose the edge. https://mui.com/material-ui/api/drawer/

title: plasmic-material-ui-slider | text: marks: exprEditor — Marks indicate predetermined values to which the user can move the slider. If true the marks are spaced according the value of the step prop. If an array, it should contain objects with value and an optional label keys.
max: number — The maximum allowed value of the slider. Should not be equal to min.
min: number — The minimum allowed value of the slider. Should not be equal to max.
name: string — Name attribute of the hidden input element.
onBlur: eventHandler
Event arguments: event: object
onChange: eventHandler — Callback function that is fired when the slider's value changed.
Event arguments: event: object, value: object, activeThumb: number
onChangeCommitted: eventHandler — Callback function that is fired when the pointer or touch interaction ends.
Event arguments: event: object, value: object
onClick: eventHandler
Event arguments: event: object
onFocus: eventHandler
Event arguments: event: object
onKeyDown: eventHandler
Event arguments: event: object
orientation: choice — The component orientation.
role: string
scale: exprEditor — A transformation function, to change the scale of the slider.
